    (hb : ∀ i ∈ s, IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) atTop (F i))
    (hc : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) atTop (F i)) :
    limsup (fun n ↦ s.sup' hs (fun i ↦ F i n)) atTop = s.sup' hs (fun i ↦ limsup (F i) atTop) :=
  limsup_finset_sup' hs hc hb

-- c: generalised, coboundedness only for some index (as the first half uses), same proof
theorem limsup_finset_sup'_test [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder β] {f : Filter α}
    {F : ι → α → β} {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (h₁ : ∃ i ∈ s, f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (F i))
    (h₂ : ∀ i ∈ s, f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (F i) := by exact fun _ _ ↦ by isBoundedDefault) :
    limsup (fun a ↦ sup' s hs (fun i ↦ F i a)) f = sup' s hs (fun i ↦ limsup (F i) f) := by
  have bddsup := isBoundedUnder_le_finset_sup' hs h₂
  apply le_antisymm
  · have cobddsup := isCoboundedUnder_le_finset_sup' hs h₁
    refine (limsup_le_iff cobddsup bddsup).2 (fun b hb ↦ ?_)
    simp only [gt_iff_lt, sup'_lt_iff, eventually_all_finset] at hb ⊢
    exact fun i i_s ↦ eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt (hb i i_s) (h₂ i i_s)
  · apply Finset.sup'_le hs (fun i ↦ limsup (F i) f)
    refine fun i i_s ↦ limsup_le_limsup (Eventually.of_forall (fun a ↦ ?_)) (by isBoundedDefault) bddsup
    simp only [le_sup'_iff]
    use i, i_s

  sorry

-- c: generalised, drop `[∀ i, SigmaFinite (μ i)]`, same proof
lemma pi_map_piCongrLeft_test1 [Fintype ι'] (e : ι ≃ ι') {β : ι' → Type*}
    [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (β i)] (μ : (i : ι') → Measure (β i)) :
    (Measure.pi fun i ↦ μ (e i)).map (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun i ↦ β i) e)
      = Measure.pi μ := by
  let e_meas : ((b : ι) → β (e b)) ≃ᵐ ((a : ι') → β a) :=
    MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun i ↦ β i) e
  refine Measure.pi_eq (fun s _ ↦ ?_) |>.symm
  rw [e_meas.measurableEmbedding.map_apply]
  let s' : (i : ι) → Set (β (e i)) := fun i ↦ s (e i)
  have : e_meas ⁻¹' pi univ s = pi univ s' := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_preimage, Set.mem_pi, mem_univ, forall_true_left, s']
    refine (e.forall_congr ?_).symm
    intro i
    rw [MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft_apply_apply e x i]
  simp only [pi_pi, this]
  exact Fintype.prod_equiv _ _ _ (congrFun rfl)

-- c: usage, Kernel version, first marginal of a product set with `t = univ`
example {α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} [CountableOrCountablyGenerated α β]
    {κ : Kernel α (β × Ω)} [IsFiniteKernel κ] (a : α) {s : Set β} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    κ a (s ×ˢ Set.univ) = Kernel.fst κ a s := by
  rw [← ProbabilityTheory.setLIntegral_condKernel_eq_measure_prod a hs MeasurableSet.univ]
  simp

-- c: family, Measure version from the Kernel version via `Kernel.const`
example {s : Set β} (hs : MeasurableSet s) {t : Set Ω} (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    ∫⁻ b in s, ρ.condKernel b t ∂ρ.fst = ρ (s ×ˢ t) := by
  have := ProbabilityTheory.setLIntegral_condKernel_eq_measure_prod
    (κ := Kernel.const Unit ρ) () hs ht
  simpa [Measure.condKernel] using this
